name: Euler decomposition of the Hadamard
summary: The Hadamard gate is a sequence of three π/2 rotations, Z–X–Z.
description:
Up to a global phase, the Hadamard gate is equal to a π/2 Z-rotation, followed by a π/2 X-rotation, followed by a π/2 Z-rotation. By colour-swapping, also H = X(π/2) Z(π/2) X(π/2); by conjugating, the same holds with all phases −π/2 (with the inverse global phase).

This rule is what makes the Hadamard derivable from the spiders, so that in the Clifford fragment the Hadamard does not need to be a separate generator.
